source.outcome_status: opened development evidence; no result from this study is confirmatory
source.time_status: GitHub pull-request createdAt projection with public outcomes projected to Task arrival; source-time-safe counterfactual only

research_contract.target: Determine whether source-time-eligible other-repository evidence can learn a response-relevant Task representation and whether observable target-repository history can forecast the next Task cohort in that representation strongly enough to justify one budgeted Selection experiment.
research_contract.runtime_boundary: Deployment remains one target repository, one local Task Pool, and one local Selection. Other repositories are offline fitting evidence and never contribute candidate Tasks.
research_contract.primary_outcome_if_selection_is_reached: held-out-configuration pass-rate MAE between a ten-Task Selection and the future cohort, aggregated configuration then Origin within repository then repository equally
research_contract.claim_boundary: The signal cascade may nominate one fixed experiment-layer Selector for independent later confirmation. It cannot establish strict historical replay, source-family portability, prospective validity, or a Runner default.
non_solutions: using target-repository outcomes to train the response projection
using target future Task text, embeddings, identities, or outcomes before freezing Selection
using cutoff-later Tasks or projected Results from another repository
pooling candidate Tasks from multiple repositories
treating static task-to-response prediction as future-distribution prediction
promoting a high random percentile without beating full history
searching projection rank, model family, regularization, embedding, forecast order, budget, horizon, clipping rule, or gate after replay
opening the sealed SWE-bench Agent holdout
adding a trainer framework, model registry, embedding service, or multi-repository Runner

rolling_origin.repository_sets: reuse the exact H5 wide/deep and H10 common/deep repository sets from the bound selector plan
rolling_origin.training_cutoff: for target Origin cutoff tau, every fitting Task must belong to another repository and have projected created_at no later than tau
rolling_origin.result_availability: public Result is projected to its Task created_at; this is counterfactual and must never be relabeled strict historical replay
rolling_origin.outer_holdout: exclude the complete target repository from every fitted response direction
rolling_origin.repository_weighting: center within each fitting repository and average repository covariance directions equally

representation.aggregate: g[a] is the equal-repository mean of g[s,a]
representation.standardization: center and scale each coordinate using equally weighted fitting-repository coordinate moments
representation.zero_signal_rule: drop a coordinate whose aggregate covariance norm or training scale is at most 1e-12; reject the representation if no coordinate remains
representation.fit_scope: one representation per target repository, Origin cutoff, and retained configuration set
representation.theory: repository-centered response covariance removes repository base rates and projects the fixed semantic representation onto directions that transfer Agent-response contrast across repositories

forecast.history_blocks: partition target history from the newest Task backward into complete horizon-sized blocks; ignore only the oldest incomplete remainder
forecast.rule: fit an ordinary least-squares line from chronological block index to each mean z coordinate and extrapolate exactly one block
forecast.fallback: if fewer than two complete blocks exist, use the complete-history z mean
forecast.parameters: no learned rank, window, trend order, shrinkage weight, threshold, or target-outcome tuning

selection_if_signal_passes.evaluation_form: leave one configuration out: omit its response direction from fitting, forecast, and Selection; evaluate only that configuration
selection_if_signal_passes.rule: greedy forward mean matching to the forecast z vector followed by at most 20 deterministic improving one-for-one swap passes

stage_a_response_representation.metric: For every target Origin and configuration with both terminal classes in its future cohort, compute future-task ROC AUC of z[t,a] for y[t,a]; average valid configurations within Origin, Origins within repository, then repositories equally.
requirements: H5 repository-macro AUC is greater than 0.5
the repository bootstrap 95 percent lower bound is greater than 0.5
at least 9 of 13 H5 repositories have mean AUC greater than 0.5
every H5 leave-one-repository-out macro AUC is greater than 0.5
at least one valid coordinate and one valid AUC row exist for every H5 repository
nineteen deterministic within-fitting-repository outcome permutations give an as-good-or-better rate below 0.10
stage_a_response_representation.failure_action: retire ALG-013 without evaluating forecast or Selection

stage_b_target_future_increment.metric: mean squared distance per retained z coordinate between the forecast centroid and actual future centroid
stage_b_target_future_increment.primary_baseline: complete target-history z centroid under the same fitted representation
controls: OLS forecast in the unmodified 384-dimensional embedding
requirements: H5 repository-macro forecast loss is at least 10 percent lower than the complete-history baseline
at least 10 of 13 H5 repositories have negative forecast-minus-baseline difference
every H5 leave-one-repository-out macro difference is negative
H5 deep macro difference is negative
H5 RCP forecast loss is lower than latest-h RCP and raw-embedding OLS controls
H10 common-11 macro and deep differences are negative with at least 8 of 11 repositories favorable
short- and long-calendar-span H5 groups both have negative difference
one hundred ninety-nine repository-block circular shifts give an as-good-or-better rate below 0.10
stage_b_target_future_increment.failure_action: retire ALG-013 without materializing an outcome Selection

stage_c_budgeted_selection.run_condition: all Stage A and Stage B requirements pass exactly
controls: raw-embedding OLS forecast with the same optimizer
requirements: H5 held-out-configuration repository-macro difference is at most -0.010
at least 10 of 13 H5 repositories and every H5 leave-one-repository-out view are favorable
H5 deep difference is negative
H10 common-11 and deep differences are negative with at least 8 of 11 repositories favorable
H5 is better than at least 75 percent of equal-budget random draws and H10 is not below the random median
candidate H5 loss is lower than every static, recent, raw-semantic, and unchanged ALG-007 control
leave-one-model, leave-one-harness, and leave-one-language refits preserve negative macro direction
a model-family by harness-family double-holdout audit does not reverse the aggregate direction
a target-history circular-shift null has corrected lower-tail rate below 0.10
stage_c_budgeted_selection.failure_action: retire ALG-013 and stop candidate invention on the current opened sources

report: training repository, Task, cutoff, and representation digests
model, harness, configuration, and double-holdout directions if Selection is reached
negative controls and exact stopping decision

resource_boundary.allowed_compute: local CPU with the already materialized ignored embeddings and committed sparse public outcomes
